observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A scenic, lush green forest with tall trees and dirt ground outdoors.
observation.formation_and_space: Solo performance, stationary or turning within a small space.
observation.posture: Upright torso, relaxed posture, slight knee flexion during turns and drops to the floor.

observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held out at shoulder or overhead height, hands moving fluidly or holding a metal tray/prop.

observation.levels_jumps_turns: Continuous spinning turns, dropping down to a seated position on the floor and rising back up.

observation.cannot_infer: Exact footwork details and precise weight distribution are obscured by the long, full flared skirt and digital video compression/resolution.

Fast circular turning steps with arms moving gracefully overhead.
Full body 360-degree spins making the colorful striped skirt flare out.
Kneeling on the ground with the full skirt spread in a circle while moving hands expressively.
